title: Lebesgue measure of the closure of a set in ℝᵐ is at most ωₘ(diam)ᵐ
statement: For every m ∈ ℕ and every set S ⊆ ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m): λₘ(closure S) ≤ λₘ(B₁(0))·(diam S)ᵐ, where λₘ is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝᵐ, B₁(0) is the open unit ball centred at 0, diam S ∈ [0, ∞] is the extended diameter, and the m-th power is taken in [0, ∞] (x⁰ = 1 for every x; ∞ᵐ = ∞ for m ≥ 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn m)), volume (closure S) ≤ volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn m) 1) * Metric.ediam S ^ m
